firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi everyone, we wrote up our experiments for the paper track and are sharing the code here, as the rules ask for public code.

Repo: https://github.com/so-nerdyy/gemma-agent-rl-paper

Short version: we got verifier-grounded GRPO with a rank-16 LoRA adapter running on the free 4xL4 machine, and Kaggle's scorer accepts the adapter. But it didn't help. On 76 held-out runs it solved 15 vs 16 for the base model. Five prompt edits didn't help either, and halving the thinking budget made the agent clearly worse (20 vs 29 solves on 64 paired runs).

We don't think this means GRPO can't work here. The problem was signal. Gemma either solved a task almost every time or never, so only about 10 of our training tasks gave GRPO anything to learn from. If you try RL, check first how many tasks your model solves only sometimes.

Also, identical baseline runs moved by about 5 points for us, so be careful reading small leaderboard changes.

The repo has the training code, the A/B test runners and our full lab journal. Agent trajectories are left out because they contain task text. Happy to answer questions.
